title: Hold a CASA certificate to run a flight training school
what: Hold a Part 141 certificate (or approval) from the Civil Aviation Safety Authority before conducting Part 141 flight training.

sources.title: Civil Aviation Safety Regulations 1998
sources.quote: 141.050 Part 141 flight training—requirement for Part 141 certificate or approval (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person conducts Part 141 flight training; and (b) the person does not meet the requirement mentioned in subregulation (2).

reach.note: Calibration: coded for the calibration classes; other aviation training classes follow in phase C.
